scheme_name: Grant-in-Aid Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance To The Mahila Mandals/ Women’s Self-help Groups (SWAWLAMBHAN)
other_conditions: Must have valid registration with the Department of Women & Child Development, Panaji‑Goa
Must be operating successfully within the State of Goa
Must have a minimum of 20 members in the Mahila Mandal/ Women’s Self‑Help Group
benefits_summary: Provides an annual grant of ₹20,000 per group, plus ₹5,000 for training/orientation and a ₹5,000 honorarium for master trainers per course.
